claims.assertion: Mari says Toleka intelligence crew combines internet monitoring, drone and broadcast reports, and information shared by the Federation and other races.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says onboard computers model likely Earth outcomes, then Taygetan ship councils discuss the data at least twice weekly.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari argues Earth’s rulers depend on public compliance and can be blocked by sufficiently unified popular refusal.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She describes like-minded awakened people as linked by a collective unconscious that helps shift Earth toward a positive timeline.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
